title: 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling
title_zh: 4LC：用于动态世界建模中高效条件化的四维潜在缓存

paragraphs.en: For video generation in dynamic world modeling, observed static and dynamic content should be efficiently reused to provide conditions for repeated generation at different times and viewpoints. We introduce 4LC, a 4D latent cache with composite visual representations and a flexible spatiotemporal access interface. As a latent cache, 4LC directly reuses visual representations of static and dynamic content to provide generation conditions, avoiding per-request RGB rendering and re-encoding. As a composite cache, 4LC binds visual representations from multiple visual encoders (e.g., VAE, DINO, V-JEPA, VGGT) to shared geometry and motion, allowing the composite representations to describe the dynamic world with rich information. Besides, we design a flexible spatiotemporal interface, which directly reads the cache at independently specified times and viewpoints and combines readouts across observations, providing a common conditioning format for diverse downstream tasks. Building on 4LC, we develop 4LC-Video to address multiple video generation tasks through different configurations of source observations, spatiotemporal requests, and historical reuse, including camera control, temporal control, novel-view synthesis, scene revisits, and long-term generation. Our experiments show more efficient condition acquisition, effective spatiotemporal controllability, and scene consistency across tasks using a single 4LC-Video model without task-specific fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 在动态世界建模的视频生成中，应高效地复用观测到的静态和动态内容，为不同时间和视角下的重复生成提供条件。 我们提出了 4LC，这是一种包含复合视觉表示和灵活时空访问接口的 4D 潜在缓存。 作为潜在缓存，4LC 直接复用静态和动态内容的视觉表示以提供生成条件，从而避免每次请求都进行 RGB 渲染和重新编码。 作为复合缓存，4LC 将来自多个视觉编码器（例如 VAE、DINO、V-JEPA、VGGT）的视觉表示与共享的几何结构和运动绑定，使这些复合表示能够以丰富的信息描述动态世界。 此外，我们设计了一种灵活的时空接口，该接口可以直接在独立指定的时间和视角下读取缓存，并跨不同观测结果整合读取内容，为多样化的下游任务提供统一的条件格式。 基于 4LC，我们开发了 4LC-Video，通过源观测、时空请求和历史复用的不同配置来解决多种视频生成任务，包括相机控制、时间控制、新视角合成、场景重访和长期生成。 我们的实验表明，使用单个 4LC-Video 模型无需针对特定任务进行微调，即可实现更高效的条件获取、有效的时空可控性以及跨任务的场景一致性。

paragraphs.en: In dynamic world modeling, observed scene information provides conditions for video generation at specified times and viewpoints. These conditions should convey persistent static structure together with dynamic content at the requested scene time. Geometry and motion help relate the observed static and dynamic content across viewpoints and scene times [ 1 , 2 ] , supporting consistency in the generated video [ 3 ] . Because the same observations serve different requests and subsequent generation segments, reusing previously extracted information can reduce the recurring cost of condition acquisition.
paragraphs.zh: 在动态世界建模中，观测到的场景信息为指定时间和视角下的视频生成提供了条件。 这些条件应当传达出静态结构的持续存在性，以及请求场景时间点的动态内容。 几何形态和运动有助于在不同视角和场景时间点之间关联观测到的静态与动态内容 [ 1 , 2 ] ，从而支持生成视频的连贯性 [ 3 ] 。 由于相同的观测结果会服务于不同的请求和后续生成片段，重复利用先前提取的信息可以降低条件获取的重复成本。

sents.en: In dynamic world modeling, observed scene information provides conditions for video generation at specified times and viewpoints.
sents.zh: 在动态世界建模中，观测到的场景信息为指定时间和视角下的视频生成提供了条件。

sents.en: These conditions should convey persistent static structure together with dynamic content at the requested scene time.
sents.zh: 这些条件应当传达出静态结构的持续存在性，以及请求场景时间点的动态内容。

sents.zh: 几何形态和运动有助于在不同视角和场景时间点之间关联观测到的静态与动态内容 [ 1 , 2 ] ，从而支持生成视频的连贯性 [ 3 ] 。

sents.zh: 由于相同的观测结果会服务于不同的请求和后续生成片段，重复利用先前提取的信息可以降低条件获取的重复成本。

paragraphs.en: Existing conditioning pipelines retain scene information in explicit 3D reconstructions or spatial memories and render it into target views [ 4 , 5 , 6 ] . Static and dynamic content can be maintained in separate components [ 7 , 8 ] or represented together through shared 4D geometry, as in 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) [ 9 ] . This shared geometry allows both to be rendered at requested times and viewpoints [ 10 ] . However, these geometric conditioning pipelines still require RGB rendering and re-encoding for each new generation request ( 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling b). This repeated processing can consume a substantial share of total generation time. Latent reuse already reduces repeated computation in video world models, both in history processing [ 11 ] and in denoising [ 12 ] . For conditioning, Mirage caches latent features with scene geometry and warps them directly to target views [ 13 ] . These features lie in the latent space of a specific generator, and dynamic content is excluded from the cache. These limitations motivate us to investigate a cache mechanism that extends latent reuse to dynamic content, enabling efficient conditioning in dynamic world modeling.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的条件生成流程将场景信息保留在显式的三维重建或空间记忆中，并将其渲染为目标视图 [4, 5, 6]。 静态和动态内容可以分别存储在独立组件中 [7, 8]，也可以通过共享的四维几何结构共同表示，例如四维高斯泼溅（4DGS）[9]。 这种共享的几何结构使得两者都能在被请求的时间和视角下进行渲染 [10]。 然而，这些基于几何结构的条件生成流程在每次新的生成请求中仍然需要进行 RGB 渲染和重新编码（4LC：动态世界建模中高效条件生成的四维潜在缓存 b）。 这种重复处理可能会消耗总生成时间的很大一部分。 潜在特征的复用已经减少了视频世界模型中的重复计算，既包括历史处理 [11]，也包括去噪过程 [12]。 在条件生成方面，Mirage 会缓存包含场景几何结构的潜在特征，并将其直接变换到目标视图 [13]。 这些特征位于特定生成器的潜在空间中，而动态内容则被排除在缓存之外。 这些局限性促使我们研究一种缓存机制，将潜在特征的复用扩展到动态内容，从而实现动态世界建模中的高效条件生成。

paragraphs.en: To this end, we introduce 4LC, a 4D latent cache that jointly stores visual representations of static and dynamic content extracted by multiple visual encoders ( 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling a). Motion determines the 3D positions associated with cached representations at the requested scene time, with static content held at its reference position. These visual representations are bound to the same geometry and motion while retaining their own formats, allowing their complementary information to be used together for conditioning. 4LC provides a spatiotemporal interface that directly reads these representations at independently specified times and viewpoints, combining readouts across observations to supplement uncovered regions. Once observations are cached, subsequent requests read the stored representations directly instead of rendering and re-encoding them ( 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling b), reducing condition-acquisition latency and peak GPU memory ( 4LC: 4D Latent Cache for Efficient Conditioning in Dynamic World Modeling c).
paragraphs.zh: 为此，我们提出了 4LC，这是一种四维潜在缓存，能够联合存储由多个视觉编码器提取的静态和动态内容的视觉表示（4LC：用于动态世界建模中高效条件设置的四维潜在缓存 a）。 运动决定了在请求的场景时间点上与缓存表示相关的三维位置，而静态内容则保持在其参考位置上。 这些视觉表示与相同的几何结构和运动绑定，同时保留各自的形式，从而使其互补信息能够被联合用于条件设置。4LC 提供了一个时空接口，可以直接在独立指定的时间和视角读取这些表示，并结合不同观察中的读取结果以补充未覆盖的区域。 一旦观察结果被缓存，后续请求将直接读取已存储的表示，而无需重新渲染和编码（4LC：用于动态世界建模中高效条件设置的四维潜在缓存 b），从而降低了条件获取的延迟和 GPU 峰值内存占用（4LC：用于动态世界建模中高效条件设置的四维潜在缓存 c）。

paragraphs.en: We develop 4LC-Video, which includes a spatiotemporal condition adapter to align the rich visual representations of 4LC with a pretrained video diffusion model for downstream video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了 4LC-Video，它包含一个时空条件适配器，用于将 4LC 丰富的视觉表示与预训练的视频扩散模型对齐，以实现下游视频生成任务。

paragraphs.en: Without task-specific fine-tuning, a single 4LC-Video model achieves state-of-the-art control accuracy and scene consistency across five generation tasks spanning spatiotemporal control, view synthesis, and long-term generation. 4LC accelerates condition acquisition by up to 68.5 × 68.5\times with 12.6 × 12.6\times lower peak GPU memory and reduces its share of end-to-end generation time from 14.9% to 0.25%, paving a new route for efficient conditioning and multi-task video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 无需针对特定任务进行微调，单个 4LC-Video 模型即可在涵盖时空控制、视角合成和长期生成的五个生成任务中，实现业界领先的控制精度与场景一致性。4LC 将条件获取速度提升了高达 68.5 × 68.5\times，同时峰值 GPU 内存使用量降低了 12.6 × 12.6\times，并将端到端生成时间中的占比从 14.9% 降至 0.25%，为高效的条件注入和多任务视频生成开辟了一条新路径。

paragraphs.en: Dynamic world modeling aims at controllable video generation within a persistent scene that evolves over time [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] . BulletTime [ 18 ] and SpaceTimePilot [ 19 ] control viewpoint and scene time as separate inputs, including frozen and reversed motion. Spatia [ 5 ] maintains consistency across segments by updating a point-cloud memory. WorldMem [ 20 ] and VMem [ 21 ] retrieve past views by field-of-view overlap and surfel indexing, respectively. Interactive world models support long-term generation over successive segments [ 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 ] . WorldKV [ 11 ] retrieves relevant cached history and GIM-World [ 27 ] compresses past observations into compact memory. When scene time advances between visits, dynamic content must also remain coherent [ 28 , 29 ] . LiveWorld [ 7 ] simulates out-of-sight dynamics, and VerseCrafter [ 8 ] separates a static point cloud from per-object trajectories. To avoid the complexity of maintaining separate components, 4LC binds representations of static and dynamic content to shared geometry and motion, reading them flexibly at independently specified times and viewpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 动态世界建模旨在持续场景内生成可控的视频，该场景会随时间演变 [ 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] 。 BulletTime [ 18 ] 和 SpaceTimePilot [ 19 ] 将视角和场景时间作为独立的输入进行控制，包括冻结和倒放运动。 Spatia [ 5 ] 通过更新点云记忆来保持各片段之间的一致性。 WorldMem [ 20 ] 和 VMem [ 21 ] 分别通过视场重叠和表面元索引来检索过去的视角。 交互式世界模型支持在连续片段中实现长期生成 [ 22 , 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 ] 。 WorldKV [ 11 ] 检索相关的缓存历史，而 GIM-World [ 27 ] 则将过去的观察结果压缩为紧凑的记忆。 当场景时间在访问之间推进时，动态内容也必须保持连贯性 [ 28 , 29 ] 。 LiveWorld [ 7 ] 模拟视线之外的动态变化，而 VerseCrafter [ 8 ] 则将静态点云与每个物体的轨迹分离。 为避免维护独立组件的复杂性，4LC 将静态和动态内容的表示绑定到共享的几何结构和运动上，并可在独立指定的时间和视角下灵活读取。

paragraphs.en: Reconstruction-based video generation guides video models with renderings of reconstructed geometry. Several methods condition generation on point-cloud or 3D-cache renderings to complete unseen or poorly reconstructed regions [ 4 , 30 ] . For dynamic scenes, 4DGS [ 9 ] and feed-forward 4D reconstruction [ 31 , 32 , 33 , 34 ] model geometry and motion, and NeoVerse [ 10 ] renders them at requested times and viewpoints as conditions. TrajectoryCrafter [ 35 ] and Vista4D [ 36 ] redirect the camera of monocular videos through point-cloud renderings that preserve source motion. These pipelines re-encode rendered RGB views for every generation request. Feature-space approaches instead condition on features carried by reconstructed geometry [ 37 , 38 , 39 ] . MVSplat360 [ 40 ] and Splatent [ 41 ] render Gaussian features into diffusion latents for novel-view synthesis. Mirage [ 13 ] warps cached latent features to target views. MVSplat360, Splatent, and Mirage avoid target RGB encoding, yet their features lie in a specific generator’s latent space and cover only static content. For efficient conditioning, 4LC reads out cached representations directly without per-request re-encoding, and its multi-encoder representations add complementary information.
paragraphs.zh: 基于重建的视频生成通过重建几何结构的渲染结果来引导视频模型。 多种方法将生成过程的条件建立在点云或三维缓存的渲染结果上，以补全未观察到或重建不充分的区域 [4, 30]。 对于动态场景，4DGS [9] 和前馈式四维重建 [31, 32, 33, 34] 会建模几何结构与运动，而 NeoVerse [10] 则根据请求的时间与视角将其渲染为条件输入。 TrajectoryCrafter [35] 和 Vista4D [36] 通过保留原始运动的点云渲染结果来重新引导单目视频的相机视角。 这些流程在每次生成请求时都会对渲染出的 RGB 视图进行重新编码。 特征空间方法则转而以重建几何结构所携带的特征作为条件输入 [37, 38, 39]。 MVSplat360 [40] 和 Splatent [41] 将高斯特征渲染为扩散潜变量，用于新视角的合成。 Mirage [13] 通过对缓存的潜在特征进行形变来适配目标视角。 MVSplat360、Splatent 和 Mirage 避免了目标 RGB 的编码，但其特征局限于特定生成器的潜在空间，且仅覆盖静态内容。 为实现高效的条件输入，4LC 无需每次请求都重新编码，而是直接读取缓存的表示；其多编码器表示还提供了互补信息。

paragraphs.en: The core of 4LC is a cache 𝒞 = { 𝒞 q } q = 0 Q − 1 \mathcal{C}=\{\mathcal{C}_{q}\}_{q=0}^{Q-1} and a spatiotemporal interface equipped with three operations. Each entry 𝒞 q \mathcal{C}_{q} stores the visual representations of its source observations, bound to their 3D geometry and motion, and 𝒞 \mathcal{C} organizes these entries by insertion order q q . Construction encodes source observations with multiple visual encoders and stores their visual representations in a new cache entry ( Fig. 2 a). Readout propagates an entry’s geometry to requested times and projects it through independently specified target cameras, reusing stored representations to produce readout features and coverage masks for static and dynamic content ( Fig. 2 b). Composition uses these masks to combine readouts across selected entries, filling uncovered regions while retaining existing readouts ( Fig. 2 c). 4LC-Video conditions a pretrained video diffusion model on these readouts ( Sec. 3.4 ). Appendix Sections A.1 and A.2 detail the implementation of 4LC and 4LC-Video, respectively.

paragraphs.en: Visual representations differ in spatial resolution, temporal sampling, and feature dimension. A condition adapter aligns the outputs of Readout or Composition to the generator’s spatiotemporal latent grid, using coverage masks to exclude missing values ( Fig. 3 ). Spatial alignment interpolates masked features and normalizes by interpolated coverage, keeping uncovered locations at zero. Temporal alignment maps the initial readout to the first latent step and aggregates subsequent readouts within each latent time interval, averaging valid contributions and recording their coverage. Separate linear projections map the aligned representations, merged coverage mask, and target-camera rays before concatenation and fusion into 𝐡 cond \mathbf{h}_{\mathrm{cond}} .
paragraphs.zh: 视觉表示在空间分辨率、时间采样和特征维度上存在差异。 条件适配器将读取或组合的输出与生成器的时空潜在网格对齐，并使用覆盖掩码排除缺失值（图3）。 空间对齐通过插值填充被掩码的特征，并根据插值后的覆盖度进行归一化，使未覆盖的位置保持为零。 时间对齐将初始读取映射到第一个潜在步骤，并在每个潜在时间区间内聚合后续读取，对有效贡献取平均并记录其覆盖度。 独立的线性投影分别对对齐后的表示、合并的覆盖掩码和目标相机射线进行映射，随后进行拼接并融合为 𝐡 cond \mathbf{h}_{\mathrm{cond}}。

paragraphs.en: 4LC-Video uses Wan2.1-T2V-14B [ 43 ] with a VACE control branch [ 44 ] and the pretrained NeoVerse reconstructor [ 10 ] for geometry and motion estimation. Training uses 200K monocular clips from SpatialVID [ 47 ] , RealCam-Vid [ 48 ] , and OpenVid [ 49 ] without paired multiview supervision. paragraphs.en: We evaluate a single 4LC-Video checkpoint on the five tasks in Fig. 3 without task-specific fine-tuning. paragraphs.en: 4LC-Video attains the lowest camera errors together with the highest subject and background consistency ( Table 2 ), whereas the baselines trade one for the other: NeoVerse follows the cameras with lower consistency, GEN3C and SpaceTimePilot stay consistent but close to static views with several-fold camera errors, and TrajectoryCrafter trails on both. 4LC-Video avoids this trade-off because 4LC keeps static structure persistent and dynamic content accurate. GEN3C, TrajectoryCrafter, and NeoVerse instead render conditions from reconstructed point clouds or 4DGS, whose artifacts and holes appear on moving subjects and static structures in NeoVerse outputs, while 4LC-Video stays faithful to the source observations ( Fig. 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 4LC-Video 实现了最低的相机误差，同时具有最高的主体和背景一致性（表 2），而基线模型则在两者之间相互取舍：NeoVerse 跟随相机运动但一致性较低，GEN3C 和 SpaceTimePilot 虽然保持一致性，但其结果接近静态视图且相机误差高出数倍，TrajectoryCrafter 在这两方面均表现不佳。4LC-Video 之所以能避免这种权衡，是因为 4LC 能够保持静态结构的持久性和动态内容的准确性。 GEN3C、TrajectoryCrafter 和 NeoVerse 则是从重建的点云或 4DGS 中渲染场景条件，其伪影和空洞会出现在 NeoVerse 输出中的移动主体和静态结构上，而 4LC-Video 则始终忠实于原始观测数据（图 4）。

paragraphs.en: 4LC-Video keeps this advantage under temporal control ( Table 2 ), while the baselines show the same trade-off. For time and camera pairs never observed together, 4LC reads each moving subject from its own observations and moves it by its estimated motion, while static structure stays in place. SpaceTimePilot generates the retimed motion without explicit conditions, and NeoVerse renders it from 4DGS with the artifacts noted above. In the frozen-time examples of Fig. 4 , 4LC-Video holds the subject at frame 0 and keeps later-observed background intact, whereas NeoVerse deforms the subject inconsistently.
paragraphs.zh: 4LC-Video 在时间控制上保持了这一优势（表 2），而基线模型则表现出相同的权衡。 对于从未同时被观测到的时间和摄像头组合，4LC 会从各自的观测数据中读取每个移动主体，并根据估计的运动进行移动，而静态结构则会保持原处不变。 SpaceTimePilot 无需显式条件即可生成重新定时的运动，而 NeoVerse 则从 4DGS 中渲染出这种运动，并出现了上述提到的伪影。 在图 4 的冻结时间示例中，4LC-Video 将主体固定在第 0 帧，并保持后续观测到的背景完整，而 NeoVerse 则对主体进行了不一致的形变。

paragraphs.en: 4LC-Video obtains the best novel-view LPIPS with PSNR within 0.1 dB of LiveWorld, and it exceeds ViewCrafter, FlexWorld, Voyager, and Spatia on all three metrics ( Table 3 ). For static scenes, 4LC reuses the cached visual representations of the image without RGB rendering and re-encoding, so its conditions avoid the information loss of these steps. Mirage attains higher SSIM at a higher output resolution ( 1280 × 704 1280\times 704 versus 560 × 336 560\times 336 ), while its PSNR and LPIPS are worse than those of 4LC-Video. Scene revisits expose accumulated drift. 4LC-Video leads LiveWorld by 1.84 dB in PSNR C and attains the best LPIPS C . The baselines update their point clouds or spatial memories with generated views along the path, allowing intermediate errors to re-enter the conditions of return views. Reusing one source-image entry, 4LC gives each revisited camera the same condition regardless of intermediate outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 4LC-Video在新型视角的LPIPS指标上表现最佳，其PSNR与LiveWorld的差距在0.1 dB以内，并且在所有三项指标上均优于ViewCrafter、FlexWorld、Voyager和Spatia（表3）。 对于静态场景，4LC无需进行RGB渲染和重新编码，即可复用图像的缓存视觉表示，因此其条件避免了这些步骤中的信息损失。 Mirage在更高输出分辨率（1280 × 704 1280\times 704 对比 560 × 336 560\times 336）下获得了更高的SSIM，但其PSNR和LPIPS表现不如4LC-Video。 场景重访会暴露累积的漂移。在PSNR C指标上，4LC-Video比LiveWorld领先1.84 dB，并且实现了最佳的LPIPS C。 基线模型会沿着路径使用生成的视角来更新其点云或空间记忆，这使得中间阶段的错误可能重新进入返回视角的条件中。 通过复用单个源图像条目，4LC无论中间输出如何，都为每个重访的摄像头提供相同的条件。

sents.en: 4LC-Video obtains the best novel-view LPIPS with PSNR within 0.1 dB of LiveWorld, and it exceeds ViewCrafter, FlexWorld, Voyager, and Spatia on all three metrics ( Table 3 ).
sents.zh: 4LC-Video在新型视角的LPIPS指标上表现最佳，其PSNR与LiveWorld的差距在0.1 dB以内，并且在所有三项指标上均优于ViewCrafter、FlexWorld、Voyager和Spatia（表3）。

sents.en: For static scenes, 4LC reuses the cached visual representations of the image without RGB rendering and re-encoding, so its conditions avoid the information loss of these steps.
sents.zh: 对于静态场景，4LC无需进行RGB渲染和重新编码，即可复用图像的缓存视觉表示，因此其条件避免了这些步骤中的信息损失。

sents.zh: Mirage在更高输出分辨率（1280 × 704 1280\times 704 对比 560 × 336 560\times 336）下获得了更高的SSIM，但其PSNR和LPIPS表现不如4LC-Video。

sents.zh: 场景重访会暴露累积的漂移。在PSNR C指标上，4LC-Video比LiveWorld领先1.84 dB，并且实现了最佳的LPIPS C。

sents.en: The baselines update their point clouds or spatial memories with generated views along the path, allowing intermediate errors to re-enter the conditions of return views.
sents.zh: 基线模型会沿着路径使用生成的视角来更新其点云或空间记忆，这使得中间阶段的错误可能重新进入返回视角的条件中。

sents.en: Reusing one source-image entry, 4LC gives each revisited camera the same condition regardless of intermediate outputs.
sents.zh: 通过复用单个源图像条目，4LC无论中间输出如何，都为每个重访的摄像头提供相同的条件。

paragraphs.en: Reuse across generated segments separates the MBench-A baselines, which either preserve the environment or evolve the scene ( Table 4 ). HY-WorldPlay and Infinite-World score high on spatial and rendering metrics but low on state evolution, as their scenes remain overly static [ 58 ] . Yume-1.5 and LingBot-World evolve scene states but lose spatial consistency. 4LC-Video bridges the two with the highest Environment and Causal scores. Each generated segment is appended to 4LC as a new entry, and later segments reuse only the static units of earlier entries as history through Composition. Revisited structure is thus constrained, while past motion is not replayed and scene states can keep evolving. Return views reproduce the outbound content, whereas HY-WorldPlay shifts the layout of revisited regions ( Fig. 6 in Appendix A.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 跨生成片段的重用使 MBench-A 基线模型区分开来，这些模型要么保留环境，要么演化场景（表 4）。 HY-WorldPlay 和 Infinite-World 在空间与渲染指标上得分较高，但在状态演化方面得分较低，因为其场景过于静态 [58]。 Yume-1.5 和 LingBot-World 能够演化场景状态，但会失去空间一致性。4LC-Video 则在这两者之间取得了平衡，获得了最高的环境与因果性得分。 每个生成的片段都会作为新条目追加到 4LC 中，而后续片段仅通过“组合”机制重用早期条目的静态单元作为历史。 因此，重访的结构受到限制，但过去的运动不会被重播，场景状态也能持续演化。 返回视角会重现出发时的内容，而 HY-WorldPlay 则会改变已重访区域的整体布局（附录 A.4 中的图 6）。

paragraphs.en: Condition acquisition accounts for 14.9% of the 18.47 s end-to-end generation time in NeoVerse, compared with 0.25% of 16.19 s for 4LC-Video under the same generation settings, and this overhead recurs across segments in long-term generation. In Fig. 5 , NeoVerse, LiveWorld, and 4LC-Video all use the Wan2.1 backbone and VAE encoder for 81-frame requests at 560 × 336 560\times 336 ( Appendix A.3 ). The conditioning paths in NeoVerse [ 10 ] and LiveWorld [ 7 ] render image-resolution RGB views from 4DGS and RGB point clouds, respectively, followed by VAE encoding ( Fig. 5 , left). 4LC readout directly projects cached representations onto lower-resolution feature grids without repeated encoding. Compared with 4DGS rendering followed by VAE encoding in NeoVerse, 4LC readout is 68.5 × 68.5\times faster, with 12.6 × 12.6\times lower peak GPU memory. Adding DINOv2, VGGT, and V-JEPA 2.1 to Wan2.1 VAE raises readout latency from 40.14 to 196.14 ms and peak GPU memory from 0.385 to 1.245 GiB. The default FLUX.2 VAE with V-JEPA 2.1 takes 162.03 ms and 0.763 GiB, and adding DINOv2 and VGGT raises them to 255.20 ms and 1.605 GiB. All remain below the cost of rendering and encoding one representation.
paragraphs.zh: 在 NeoVerse 中，条件获取占端到端生成时间（18.47 秒）的 14.9%，而在相同生成设置下，4LC-Video 的这一比例为 0.25%（对应 16.19 秒），且这一额外开销会在长期生成的各个片段中重复出现。 在图 5 中，NeoVerse、LiveWorld 和 4LC-Video 在处理 560 × 336 分辨率的 81 帧请求时，均使用 Wan2.1 主干网络和 VAE 编码器（附录 A.3）。 NeoVerse [10] 和 LiveWorld [7] 中的条件路径分别通过 4DGS 和 RGB 点云生成图像分辨率的 RGB 视图，随后进行 VAE 编码（图 5，左侧）。而 4LC 读取则直接将缓存表示投影到低分辨率特征网格上，无需重复编码。 与 NeoVerse 中先进行 4DGS 渲染再进行 VAE 编码的方式相比，4LC 读取的速度快 68.5 倍，且峰值 GPU 内存使用量低 12.6 倍。 将 DINOv2、VGGT 和 V-JEPA 2.1 添加到 Wan2.1 VAE 中后，读取延迟从 40.14 毫秒增至 196.14 毫秒，峰值 GPU 内存使用量从 0.385 GiB 增至 1.245 GiB。 默认配置下，包含 V-JEPA 2.1 的 FLUX.2 VAE 需要 162.03 毫秒和 0.763 GiB；若再加入 DINOv2 和 VGGT，则分别增至 255.20 毫秒和 1.605 GiB。 所有这些开销均低于渲染和编码一个表示所需的成本。

paragraphs.en: A single visual representation cannot meet the representational demands of dynamic world modeling, which span appearance, semantics, geometry, and dynamics, whereas existing encoders each specialize in one of them: FLUX.2 VAE reconstructs appearance, DINOv2 learns semantic features, VGGT infers multi-view geometry, and V-JEPA 2.1 models video dynamics. Since 4LC binds these representations to shared geometry and motion, we add DINOv2, VGGT, and V-JEPA 2.1 to FLUX.2 VAE under direct readout, individually and together ( Table 5 ). Individually, DINOv2 and VGGT keep camera errors and consistency close to FLUX.2 VAE, indicating that their semantic and geometric cues are not fully exploited in pairwise combinations. V-JEPA 2.1 lowers both rotation and translation errors while leaving consistency nearly unchanged: unlike the image and multi-view encoders, it learns from video, and its temporally consistent features [ 46 ] keep high similarity after readout, bringing temporal context into the condition. Combining all four lets appearance, semantic, geometric, and dynamic cues complement one another, making it the strongest configuration: it reduces the translation error of FLUX.2 VAE combined with V-JEPA 2.1 from 0.112 to 0.101, and all four metrics match or exceed FLUX.2 VAE re-encoding. Because Readout reuses cached representations, it adds no efficiency bottleneck ( Fig. 5 , Sec. 4.3 ), so 4LC is both composite and efficient, yielding rich, high-quality 4D conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 单一的视觉表现无法满足动态世界建模的多维度需求，因为这类建模需要涵盖外观、语义、几何和动态等多个方面；而现有的编码器各自仅专注于其中一个维度：FLUX.2 VAE 重建外观，DINOv2 学习语义特征，VGGT 推断多视角几何结构，V-JEPA 2.1 则对视频动态进行建模。 由于 4LC 将这些表现绑定到共享的几何和运动信息上，我们将 DINOv2、VGGT 和 V-JEPA 2.1 以直接读取的方式添加到 FLUX.2 VAE 中，分别单独使用或组合使用（表 5）。 单独使用时，DINOv2 和 VGGT 使相机误差和一致性保持与 FLUX.2 VAE 相近，这表明它们的语义和几何线索在成对组合时并未被充分利用。 V-JEPA 2.1 降低了旋转和平移误差，同时几乎未改变一致性：与图像和多视角编码器不同，它从视频中学习，其具有时间一致性的特征 [46] 在读取后仍能保持高相似度，从而将时间上下文纳入条件中。 结合所有四个编码器后，外观、语义、几何和动态线索能够相互补充，使其成为最强的配置：该配置将 FLUX.2 VAE 与 V-JEPA 2.1 组合后的平移误差从 0.112 降低至 0.101，且所有四项指标均达到或超过了 FLUX.2 VAE 的重编码水平。 由于读取机制会复用已缓存的表现，因此不会引入效率瓶颈（图 5，第 4.3 节），这使得 4LC 既具备组合性又高效，从而生成丰富且高质量的 4D 条件。

paragraphs.en: We presented 4LC, a 4D latent cache that stores composite visual representations of static and dynamic content and reads them directly at independently requested times and viewpoints. Conditioned on these readouts, a single 4LC-Video checkpoint achieved state-of-the-art control accuracy and scene consistency across five generation tasks. By avoiding per-request RGB rendering and re-encoding, 4LC turns condition acquisition from a recurring cost into a one-time encoding of observations. Its composite representations add complementary information from multiple encoders, giving dynamic world modeling conditions that are both efficient and rich.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 4LC，这是一种四维潜在缓存，能够存储静态和动态内容的复合视觉表示，并可在独立请求的时间和视角下直接读取这些表示。 基于这些读取结果，单个 4LC-Video 检查点在五个生成任务中实现了当前最先进的控制精度和场景一致性。 通过避免每次请求都进行 RGB 渲染和重新编码，4LC 将条件获取从重复性成本转变为对观测结果的一次性编码。 其复合表示融合了多个编码器提供的互补信息，从而为动态世界建模提供了既高效又丰富的条件。

paragraphs.en: 4LC relies on a feed-forward 4D reconstruction model to estimate depth, camera parameters, and motion, and its estimation errors can affect readout quality despite training augmentation. While 4LC supports both static and dynamic content, 4LC-Video reuses only static historical content for long-term generation. We leave dynamic reuse across generation segments to future work, as a further step toward efficient conditioning for multi-task video generation.

sents.zh: 在剩余的候选项中，我们优先选择距离目标相机最近的源相机，其次是距离最近的前表面，最后是投影点最接近源和目标单元格中心的单元。

paragraphs.en: Wan2.1 latents encode the first frame alone and each later group of four frames, so readouts with target intervals of one, two, and four frames contribute four, two, and one readouts to each later latent step; for 81 frames, they give 81, 41, and 21 readouts over 21 latent steps. Target-camera rays use Plücker coordinates [ 62 ] .
paragraphs.zh: Wan2.1 的潜在变量仅对第一帧进行编码，并对之后每四帧为一组进行编码；因此，目标间隔为一、二和四帧的读取操作，会在每个后续潜在步骤中分别贡献四次、两次和一次读取；对于 81 帧而言，在 21 个潜在步骤中，它们会分别产生 81 次、41 次和 21 次读取。 目标相机射线使用普吕克坐标 [ 62 ] 。

We train the condition adapter and control branch for 20K steps on 16 NVIDIA A100 GPUs with a global batch size of 16, using AdamW [ 63 ] at a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} .
paragraphs.zh: 20万条训练剪辑包括来自 SpatialVID [47] 的10万条、来自 RealCam-Vid [48] 的4万条以及来自 OpenVid [49] 的6万条。 我们在16块 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上，以16的全局批量大小，使用学习率为 10^{-5} 的 AdamW [63] 算法，对条件适配器和控制分支进行2万步的训练。

paragraphs.en: Inspired by NeoVerse [ 10 ] , which simulates degraded conditions from monocular videos, training augmentations vary the available conditions while preserving the target video, times, and cameras.
paragraphs.zh: 受 NeoVerse [ 10 ] 的启发，该模型通过单目视频模拟退化条件；训练增强方法则在保持目标视频、时间和摄像头不变的同时，对可用条件进行变化。

paragraphs.en: Each training clip provides K K uniformly spaced keyframes, with K K drawn from 11 to 21. To expose the generator to incomplete coverage, we use two geometric augmentations. Source-frame dropout excludes selected frames from the readout candidates. Visibility culling retains source units visible from a virtual camera near each source camera, which translates laterally while looking at the scene, yaws, pitches, zooms in, or zooms out.
paragraphs.zh: 每个训练片段都提供 K 个均匀分布的关键帧，其中 K 的取值范围是 11 到 21。 为了让生成器接触不完整的覆盖情况，我们使用了两种几何增强方法。 源帧丢弃机制会从读取候选集中排除选定的帧。 可见性剔除会保留从靠近每个源摄像头的虚拟摄像头视角可见的源单元；该虚拟摄像头在观察场景时会进行横向移动、偏航、俯仰、拉近或推远操作。

sents.en: Each training clip provides K K uniformly spaced keyframes, with K K drawn from 11 to 21.
sents.zh: 每个训练片段都提供 K 个均匀分布的关键帧，其中 K 的取值范围是 11 到 21。

sents.en: To expose the generator to incomplete coverage, we use two geometric augmentations.
sents.zh: 为了让生成器接触不完整的覆盖情况，我们使用了两种几何增强方法。

sents.en: Source-frame dropout excludes selected frames from the readout candidates.
sents.zh: 源帧丢弃机制会从读取候选集中排除选定的帧。

sents.en: Visibility culling retains source units visible from a virtual camera near each source camera, which translates laterally while looking at the scene, yaws, pitches, zooms in, or zooms out.
sents.zh: 可见性剔除会保留从靠近每个源摄像头的虚拟摄像头视角可见的源单元；该虚拟摄像头在观察场景时会进行横向移动、偏航、俯仰、拉近或推远操作。

paragraphs.en: To account for uncertainty in motion estimation, we perturb the motion threshold ϵ \epsilon and construct training conditions with different motion masks. First-frame sampling restricts the observations to the initial image and constructs geometric conditions from its static state.
paragraphs.zh: 为了考虑运动估计中的不确定性，我们对运动阈值 ϵ \epsilon 进行扰动，并构建具有不同运动掩码的训练条件。 首帧采样将观测限制在初始图像上，并从其静态状态中构建几何条件。

paragraphs.en: Representation and text dropout vary the visual and textual information available to the conditioning path. Representation dropout removes selected representations and recomputes coverage from the retained ones, and text dropout replaces the text condition with the empty-prompt embedding. Table 7 lists the probabilities and ranges.
paragraphs.zh: 表示和文本丢弃会改变条件路径可用的视觉和文本信息。 表示丢弃会移除选定的表示，并根据保留的表示重新计算覆盖范围；而文本丢弃则用空提示嵌入替换文本条件。 表 7 列出了概率和范围。

paragraphs.en: As in NeoVerse [ 10 ] , test videos use K = 21 K=21 uniformly spaced keyframes, and its reconstructor estimates camera poses of generated videos. Each generated and target trajectory is expressed relative to its first frame. Camera trajectories are pan left, reversed, static, and dolly out at the original scene times; temporal trajectories are reversal, freezing, and pause-and-resume under the source cameras. Translation error excludes static-camera cases.

paragraphs.en: Acquisition latency and peak GPU memory are measured on an NVIDIA A100, averaging 50 runs after three warmup runs. Scene construction differs widely across frameworks and cannot be fully aligned: the NeoVerse reconstructor used by NeoVerse and 4LC takes 1.35 s, whereas LiveWorld takes 20.43 s. paragraphs.en: For each video, request, and encoder, we uniformly sample 2,048 tokens from the region covered by both acquisition paths. Relative representations [ 59 ] use 128 corresponding anchor features with ten anchor seeds, keeping the statistical tokens fixed across seeds. We average relative cosine similarities over seeds within each case and give all cases equal weight in Fig. 5 (right). The five requests preserve the source time and camera sequence, reverse scene time, freeze scene time, hold the camera fixed, or reverse the camera trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个视频、请求和编码器，我们从两个采集路径共同覆盖的区域中均匀采样 2048 个词元。 相对表示 [59] 使用 128 个对应的锚点特征和十个锚点种子，并在不同种子间保持统计词元不变。 我们对每个案例内的种子计算相对余弦相似度的平均值，并在图 5（右侧）中赋予所有案例相等的权重。 这五个请求分别保留源时间和相机序列、反转场景时间、冻结场景时间、固定相机或反转相机轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 6 complements the MBench-A results in Sec. 4.2 with two cases whose camera trajectory reverses midway and returns to the initial viewpoint. HY-WorldPlay [ 23 ] regenerates returned regions with shifted layouts and missing structures, and its final frame departs from the first. 4LC-Video adds each generated segment to the cache, and Composition reads out the static units of these entries for the return requests, so return views reproduce the outbound content. This consistency agrees with its highest Reprojection and Environment scores in Table 4 .
paragraphs.zh: 图 6 补充了第 4.2 节中 MBench-A 的结果，展示了两种相机轨迹在中途反转并返回初始视角的情况。 HY-WorldPlay [ 23 ] 会重新生成布局偏移且结构缺失的返回区域，其最后一帧与第一帧存在差异。4LC-Video 会将每个生成的片段添加到缓存中，而 Composition 则会从这些条目中读取静态单元以处理返回请求，因此返回视角能够重现出发时的内容。 这种一致性与其在表 4 中最高的重投影和环境得分相符。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the main model on WorldScore without fine-tuning, using the official pipeline, and compare it with published results [ 53 ] of static scene generators [ 64 , 65 , 66 , 55 ] and foundation video models [ 67 , 68 , 69 , 70 , 71 , 72 , 43 ] ( Table 8 ). 4LC-Video obtains the highest Dynamic score and the best content alignment and style consistency among these methods. Compared with Wan2.1, it raises camera controllability from 23.53 to 86.87 and 3D consistency from 78.74 to 87.97, and its Static score approaches those of static scene generators.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在未进行微调的情况下，使用官方流程在 WorldScore 上评估主模型，并将其与静态场景生成器 [64, 65, 66, 55] 和基础视频模型 [67, 68, 69, 70, 71, 72, 43] 的已发表结果 [53] 进行比较（表 8）。在这些方法中，4LC-Video 获得了最高的动态分数，以及最佳的内容对齐和风格一致性。 与 Wan2.1 相比，它将相机可控性从 23.53 提升至 86.87，3D 一致性从 78.74 提升至 87.97，且其静态分数接近静态场景生成器的水平。

paragraphs.en: Using the main model on camera trajectories, we compare disabled motion filtering ( Equation 6 ) with filtering at different thresholds ( Table 9 ). Without filtering, estimated motion on static structure enters the conditions as spurious displacement, yielding the largest camera errors and the lowest subject consistency, background consistency, temporal flickering, and motion smoothness. Training samples the threshold from 0.05 to 0.2 to account for motion-estimation uncertainty ( Table 7 ), and performance remains stable from 0.05 to 0.4, including values beyond this range, indicating robustness to the condition changes induced by threshold selection.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用主模型对相机轨迹进行分析，将禁用运动过滤（方程 6）与在不同阈值下进行的过滤（表 9）进行了比较。 如果不进行过滤，静态结构上的估计运动会以虚假位移的形式进入条件，导致最大的相机误差以及最低的主体一致性、背景一致性、时间闪烁和运动平滑度。 训练样本将阈值从 0.05 到 0.2 进行采样，以考虑运动估计的不确定性（表 7），且性能在 0.05 到 0.4 的范围内保持稳定，包括超出该范围的值，这表明模型对阈值选择所引发的条件变化具有鲁棒性。
